crossRefs.note: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to…
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph.
You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an…
Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?
They didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness…
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

translations.web: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
translations.bsb: With loving devotion You will lead the people You have redeemed; with Your strength You will guide them to Your holy dwelling.
translations.kjv: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
translations.asv: Thou in thy lovingkindness hast led the people that thou hast redeemed: Thou hast guided them in thy strength to thy holy habitation.
